The '''Sixteenth Assembly of Puducherry''' succeeds the 15th Assembly of Puducherry and will be constituted sooner following the victory of [[National Democratic Alliance]] in the [[2026 Puducherry Legislative Assembly election|2026 assembly election]] that was held on 9 April 2026.
